title: Absolute irreducibility persists on a principal coefficient open
statement: Let A be a commutative domain, K a field, and iota: A -> K an injective ring map. Let n be a natural number and P in A[t_1,...,t_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Assume that the coefficient image of P in the polynomial ring over the algebraic closure of K [def-weil-algebraic-closure] is irreducible. There is a nonzero a in A such that for every field L and ring map phi: A -> L with phi(a) nonzero, the coefficient image of P in L[t_1,...,t_n] is irreducible. K need not be the fraction field of A.

source.place: Tag 0557, lemma-irreducible-polynomial; descent along a containing-field embedding

proof.text: Compose iota with K -> AlgebraicClosure K to obtain an injective ring map j. Use IsFractionRing.lift to extend j to FractionRing A -> AlgebraicClosure K. Equip the target with the algebra structure of that ring map. IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap shows that the composite A -> FractionRing A -> AlgebraicClosure K is exactly j, so the original irreducibility hypothesis is precisely the hypothesis of MvPolynomial.bertini_noether.

Apply the proved fraction-field Bertini–Noether theorem with E = AlgebraicClosure K. Retain its nonzero element a and the irreducibility component of its specialization conclusion, discarding only the extra total-degree equality. No descent to an algebraic closure of FractionRing A or triangular coordinate change is necessary in this wrapper.

proof_origin.note: S3: proved by extending the containing-field embedding and applying the already proved source-library result.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_irreducible_specializations
    {A K : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field K]
    (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (ι : A →+* K)
    (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hP : Irreducible (map ((algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).comp ι) P)) :
    ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (φ : A →+* L),
      φ a ≠ 0 → Irreducible (map φ P)
